messages:
Leah: Quick thread to lock customer comms for last night's outage. We need a public status blurb + plan for RCAs to contracted customers.
Marcus: I can draft the status page. Keep it short: impact, what we did, next steps.
Tara: Ops confirm? Do we have the final start/end times and whether any retries caused duplicated responses?
Ibrahim: Ops: confirmed window 02:40-03:25 UTC, ~28k retries, ~420 5xx errors. No auth/data issues.
legal-bot: Legal note: public summary must state whether customer data was exposed. For full RCAs, only share under NDA/contract clauses.
Leah: Draft suggestion: "Resolved: elevated latency and intermittent failures in us-west between 02:40-03:25 UTC caused by upstream network instability affecting cache behavior. Mitigation: config rollback and cache persistence. No customer data exposed. Full RCA will be shared with affected contract customers."
Marcus: Good. Add a line: "We're scheduling a reliability review to address recurring incidents." That shows follow-through.
Tara: Action items:
- Tara (Ops): paste timeline + counts into postmortem (by 12:30 PT)
- Marcus (Product): publish status page snippet + customer email (by 6pm PT)
- Support: prepare affected-customer list and coordinate distribution (by COB)
- Legal: review full RCA and approve distribution list (by next business day)
Leah: Also create an infra-ticket to investigate 3 network flaps this quarter (owner: Ibrahim, due in 7 days).
Ibrahim: Will do and add alerting rule (rolling counter over 7 days).
Marcus: I'll avoid naming vendors; keep wording neutral. Posting draft to #incidents-drafts now for quick pass.
Leah: Thanks. Plan: public summary tonight; full RCAs to contracts after legal sign-off tomorrow.
